why: These published cards instruct with command words the current AS papers do not use. The syllabus table on page 39 lists nine words; the AS papers since 2023 use six: Identify, Define, Explain, Calculate, Analyse, Evaluate. A card that opens with any other word models a question the learner will not be set.
rule: Reword the prompt to the target command word at the target tariff. Rewrite the canonical answer and marking guidance to the answer shape and the AO split, which were read off the mark schemes’ own AO grids. Keep the objective, the cited claims and the point being taught. Recompute authored_hash. Record the rewrite in the topic’s authoring_notes.json as {from, to, why}.
